Lemma
[Differential inequality for $\Omega $] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0272, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0273 1. Lemma 9.6\group positive-section-dominates

Given a curvature operator $\mathbb P$ with $ u (\mathbb P)<0$, define \[ \Omega (\mathbb P)= rac{ r \mathbb P}{- u (\mathbb P)}-\log \! igl(- u (\mathbb P) igr). \] Then along the curvature operator of a Ricci flow solution, wherever $\Omega $ is defined one has \[ rac{d}{dt}\Omega \ge - u . \]
